title: Vertex labels from edge assignments
statement: Let $q,k,n$ be natural numbers, let a perfect matching be given in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part, and assign a label in $	ext{Fin }n$ to each matching edge. The induced labeling of the vertices assigns to each vertex the label of the matching edge containing it.
